title: Kunsthistorisches Museum
representedDate: Standing 1891 museum exterior as documented in 2009 and 2012 creator photographs and confirmed by the current property owner.
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap relation 20165 fixes the museum outline, the two inner courts and the main visitor entrance. The 173 m long structure is aligned with Maria-Theresien-Platz in the signed local frame.
sectionBasis: Original public-domain exterior views document the pedestal, arched facade bays and balustrades, projecting pavilions and dark dome. The matched museum dome height is estimated from the twin building and the main roof height from the mapped source.
limitations: The 60 m dome height follows the approximately matching tower and dome of the Natural History Museum. Architectural offsets are measured from the surviving footprint and exterior photos. Unphotographed rear courtyards, minor embellishments and small sculpture are estimates.

The museum facade is the standing configuration. Temporary coverings, banners and construction scaffolds visible in one photograph were disregarded. Some entry grades and stair geometry are approximate.
